name: VNET DC Digitalis
notes: Methodology anchor: VNET official housing page lists DC Digitalis at Trnavska cesta 110/B, Bratislava with ~1,000 m2 data halls (other sources ~3,000 m2 gross); Tier III ecological colo opened 2014, four geographically independent fibre routes >100 Gbit/s. Confirm parcel/permit via cadastre (skgeodesy.sk) in follow-up.

name: VNET SHC III
notes: VNET official housing page names SHC III at Namestie hraniciarov (Námestie Hraničiarov 39, 851 03 Bratislava per datacenters.com) as operational; one of VNET's three Bratislava data centers. Capacity not published.

name: VNET Datapark 48
notes: VNET official page lists Datapark 48 at Cernysevskeho (Černyševského), Bratislava as 'coming soon' - announced/planned, NOT operational. Track Petrzalka/Cernysevskeho permits and grid (ZSE) per SK methodology before any operational count.

name: Orange Slovensko TechPark Data Centre
notes: Official Orange page: 'najmodernejšie dátové centrum na Slovensku' with 1,026+ m2 total of which 680 m2 customer data halls; housing and virtual-data-centre services. Telecom colocation/cloud anchor in Bratislava; exact street address and Uptime certification still to be verified separately (per methodology).

name: SWAN Data Centre
notes: SWAN official data-centre service page (server housing/colocation, cloud, backup) and status page show 'Dátové centrum Operational'. Physical DC site not published on service page; legal seat Landererova 12, Bratislava. Search CRZ for public-sector hosting/cloud contracts per methodology.

name: Slovak Telekom Data Centre (Bratislava)
notes: Official Telekom service page: professional housing in its data centres; DC located ~1 km from Bratislava centre, 5 km from airport, 80 km from Vienna, UPS + doubled motor generators. Individual Bratislava address remains B/C until primary address proof; capacity not published.

name: SITEL POP1 / POP2
notes: Official SITEL page: POP1 running continuously since 2000 and twin POP2 since 2001 - first neutral colocation centres in Slovakia, both Bratislava; TIER 3-standard/99.999% uptime claim per Baxtel (C/B for Tier claim until certifier record). Neutral-colocation multi-site seed per methodology.

name: 1 Cloud Lab Data Centre
notes: Official page states Bratislava data centre with colocation and public-cloud services, operating since 2000. Verify exact address and facility specs per methodology before further grading.

name: Towercom Datacentrum (Kamzik)
notes: Colocation DC in the Kamzik TV transmitter premises, Bratislava; Tier III criteria design, 480 m2 technology space, two 1250 kVA transformers (N+1) with rotary UPS and diesel energy centre, INERGEN fire suppression, connectivity to SIX/SITEL peering. capacity_mw derived from 2x1250 kVA connected transformers.

name: Perpetuus DC / DCP1
notes: Purpose-built two-storey DC at Devinska Nova Ves (Istrijska 26), Bratislava; Tier III since 2009, 3.5 MW electrical input per WebSupport (Inflect lists 2.5 MW); WebSupport runs its production infrastructure there. CM PROJECT (Trnava-based engineering firm) portfolio confirms investor CNC a.s. for building-permit documentation phase 2012-2014 (not a Trnava project).

name: Datacube Data Centre
notes: Colocation DC at Kopcianska, Petrzalka (Bratislava): borough official page describes two-storey hall with data storage spaces (2011 building record); one of the largest third-party Slovak DCs per market studies; previously hosted NASES state systems (one floor). Rentable server-hall area ~2,700 m2 per market sources; capacity not published.

name: NASES / Government Cloud (incl. SPP-hosted second DC)
notes: State cloud platform for public administration (Govnet, slovensko.sk); government_or_public_sector class - NOT commercial colo per methodology. NASES second DC hosted in SPP (Slovensky plynarensky priemysel) premises in Bratislava since end-2021; map constituent physical DCs via CRZ/MIRRI/NASES.

name: PERUN supercomputer (CSC SAV)
notes: public_HPC_research class (not commercial colo). PERUN (14.5 PFLOP/s) delivered 2025-12-18 to Centre of Common Activities of SAV, Bratislava (official SAV news); launched 27 April 2026 per TASR/ta3; forms one integrated national HPC system with the Kosice TUKE component; Eviden supplier per 2025-05 press.

name: CVTI SR research data centre modernisation call
notes: Official state call (Program Slovensko / mapapartnerstva.gov.sk, updated 19.05.2026): modernisation of CVTI SR's research datacenter (IKT infrastructure for science/research institutions), allocation EUR 21,837,787, submission deadline 15.05.2026. Government/research facility, Bratislava; announced/procurement stage.

name: SIS new data centre (planned)
notes: SIS Strategy 2025-2032 (reported Nov 2025): plans to build a new data centre and modernise technical intelligence; location not disclosed - assigned to Bratislava (SIS HQ) for coverage per round-1 convention. Announced/planned stage, no capacity published.

name: eServer SK colocation (inside DC Digitalis)
notes: Official service page: SK colocation offered in a Bratislava TIER3 ECO DC; eServer states it operates its own location inside DC Digitalis. NOT counted as a separate building (methodology dedup rule: eServer-in-Digitalis); Tier claim C/B until certifier record.

name: GTS Slovakia DC
notes: Legacy carrier data centre of GTS Slovakia (acquired by Deutsche Telekom, integrated into Slovak Telekom environment); directory-only listing, likely Bratislava; address/capacity not published. C-grade seed per methodology directory handling.

name: Platon Chemtech server room
notes: Small operator-run server room 'Chemtech' (~36 m2) located ~400 m from SIX (Slovak Internet eXchange), Bratislava; hosting/colocation provider. Minor facility included for completeness.

name: SITEL POPKE
notes: Official SITEL page states it operates three data centres: POP1/POP2 Bratislava and POPKE Kosice; Baxtel confirms POPKE in Kosice (TIER 3-standard claim). Only confirmed Kosice commercial colocation anchor per methodology; confirm exact address/permits via Kosice boards and VSE.

name: National supercomputer Kosice (TUKE component, NSCC)
developer: TUKE / NSCC consortium (CSC SAV, MIRRI, I4DI)
notes: public_HPC_research class. Postoj/ta3 (2026-04): the Kosice workplace at Technical University of Kosice is already functioning ('uz fungujucim pracoviskom v Kosiciach') and together with PERUN (Bratislava) forms one integrated national HPC system; TUKE received EUR 20.9M from the recovery plan; MIRRI/NSCC consortium (CSC SAV + MIRRI + I4DI) official direction A-grade. Track final installation/operational notices.

name: Slovak Telekom DC Kosice
notes: Directory entry: DC within existing T-Com telecom building at Polska 4, 043 06 Kosice with housing services (cages/racks/dedicated servers). Methodology: do NOT elevate directory snippets to A; needs Slovak Telekom primary facility evidence or permit/VSE record before counting as A-grade.

name: Atos/Eviden Kosice legacy DC (directory lead)
notes: Legacy Kosice data-centre entries appear in market directories (Atos/Eviden era); verify with Eviden/Atos primary pages, permits, CRZ and VSE before counting (methodology priority-unresolved lead). Status unknown.

name: Slovak Telekom DC Bzenov
notes: Hardened bunker data centre at Bzenov 082 42 (Presov district): 72h autonomy, three independent HV connections, 2x825 kVA diesel generators, 50,000 l fuel, own water source; rack/cage housing services. Operator-sourced description carried by Data Center Catalog; primary Telekom facility page not captured (would upgrade to A).

name: Geothermal Park Presov-Lubotice data centre (planned)
notes: Developer promotes a next-generation data-centre opportunity within Geothermal Park Presov - Lubotice (confirmed geothermal resource ~140-150 C, valid EIA decision, ~8.5 MWe geothermal power plant planned; absorption chillers could push PUE toward 1.2). Concept/announced stage; DC capacity not specified; route to Enviroportal/permits before counting.

name: Slovak Telekom DC Tajov
notes: Hardened bunker-type DC at Tajov 1, 976 34 Tajov (Banska Bystrica region): autonomous operation min. 6 days, resistant to nuclear/CBR/EMP/seismic/flood hazards, doubled cooling/backup/motor-generator technology per operator description (via Data Center Catalog). OCOLO claims 10.00 MW power capacity - C-grade unverified; primary Telekom page needed for A.
